test_cases.scenario: Create an order with only the required fields
preconditions: Customer C1 has a valid bearer token
Product P1 (uuid) has stock 50; product P2 (uuid) has stock 50
C1 has shipping address S1 (uuid)
steps: Send `POST /orders` with header `Authorization: Bearer <valid_token of customer C1>` and body `test_data.body`
Send `GET /orders/{id}` with the same header using `id` from the response
test_cases.expected_result: Response is `201`; body matches the Order schema: `id` is a uuid, `items` has 1 entry with productId P1 and quantity 1, `total` is a number, `createdAt` is a date-time; `GET /orders/{id}` returns the same order

gaps.description: Order status after creation, total calculation, rate limiting, idempotency of POST

coverage_summary.notes: Both endpoints and every documented status code (200, 201, 400, 401, 404, 409) are covered, with boundaries for items (0/20/21), quantity (0/10/11) and coupon length (5/13). Cross-customer access is tested as 404 per the spec. The largest risks are undocumented responses for unknown references and coupon semantics (Q-2, Q-3).

requirements.text: POST /orders creates an order from the caller's cart items
GET /orders/{orderId} returns an order by id

acceptance_criteria.text: Valid request returns 201 with an Order body
Invalid request returns 400 with an Error body (code, message, field)
Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401
Out-of-stock items return 409 with an Error body and no order is created
Existing own order returns 200 with the Order body
Missing or invalid bearer token returns 401
Unknown order, or an order of another customer, returns 404

business_rules.text: Each item requires productId (uuid) and quantity (integer 1-10)
On 201, stock is reserved for each item
